topics.title: Principles of Management, Family Living, Parenthood, and Family Nutrition

subtopics.content: Management processes, motivations, family resources, decision making, time/energy management, family types/cycle, courtship/marriage, parenthood/childcare, meal planning, and special nutritional needs
subtopics.objective: Apply management planning, organizing, implementing, and evaluating processes; analyze values, goals, standards, and family human/material resources; examine family types, life cycle stages, and conflict resolutions; understand courtship, marriage preparations, and parental responsibilities; plan balanced meals for special nutritional needs (infants, pregnant women, aged, invalids).

topics.title: Clothing the Family, Housing, Home Maintenance, and Sanitation

subtopics.content: Household linen, textile fibers/fabrics, wardrobe planning, laundry agents/processes, house selection/acquisition, equipment/furnishings, interior decoration, home utilities, cleaning agents/surfaces, safety, and sanitation
subtopics.objective: Classify textile fibers, plan wardrobes, use laundry agents, and care for garments; evaluate methods of house acquisition and selection guidelines; arrange home furnishings and master interior decoration principles; manage home utilities (water, light, fuel); use cleaning agents on various surfaces, practice accident prevention/first aid, and maintain home sanitation/waste disposal.

topics.title: Wealth Creation, Money Management, Entrepreneurship, and Consumer Education

subtopics.content: Creativity and entrepreneurship, money management, family budgeting, wealth creation methods, capital market investments, consumer rights, legislation, market surveys, and wise buying practices
subtopics.objective: Explore entrepreneurial opportunities (fashion design, fast food, bead making); construct family budgets and manage household income; identify wealth creation methods and capital market investments (stocks, treasury bills); apply consumer rights, laws, market survey procedures, and wise purchasing practices.
